issues.description: Pathological Mode Selection to GNSS During Extended Outages. In long outages where DR survivability duration T_surv < H, the DR survivability penalty Pi_DR(DR) inflates DR cost by +40m to +60m. Consequently, candidate action cost J(GNSS) becomes lower than J(DR), inducing the policy to switch to GNSS during an outage. In GNSS mode under outage, position is held via Zero-Order Hold (ZOH), causing horizontal localization error to balloon to 389.6 meters.
issues.why_it_matters: A localization error of 389.6m during highway driving is unacceptable for autonomous navigation, and reviewers will immediately criticize the policy for choosing a disabled sensor over inertial dead reckoning.
issues.recommended_correction: Enforce a hard masking rule in evaluate_action_costs: if is_sensor_outage or quality_score < 0.15, set J(GNSS) = infinity. GNSS must be strictly disqualified during verified signal outage.

issues.description: Reactive Switching Baseline Does Not Disconnect EKF Updates. In experiments/baselines.py, run_baseline_trajectory updates the background EKF with GNSS observations regardless of whether reactive_policy chose DR or HYBRID, and sets est_e = ekf_state.pos_e. Consequently, Table 1 reports identical metrics for Fixed HYBRID and Reactive Switching (ATE 0.426m), whereas in Table 5 (Ablation F) the real reactive mode gets ATE 0.7122m.
issues.why_it_matters: The reactive baseline in Table 1 is inadvertently over-optimistic because it enjoys the benefits of continuous Kalman filtering even when logged as being in DR.
issues.recommended_correction: Modify experiments/baselines.py so that when mode == 'DR', GNSS measurement updates to the EKF are rejected (matching lines 295-308 of phase5_experiments.py).

issues.description: Manual Heuristic Override Overriding Learned ML Forecast. Line 280 in phase5_experiments.py injects: 'if is_out or q_scores[i] < 0.15: forecasts['GNSS'] = max(forecasts.get('GNSS', 10.0), 30.0)'. This manually modifies the output of the machine learning forecast model before passing it to the policy.
issues.why_it_matters: Reviewers can argue that VYRA is not purely forecast-driven, but relies on heuristic rule patching to handle outages.
issues.recommended_correction: Ensure the training targets for GNSS counterfactuals during simulated outages reflect the true ZOH error, allowing the XGBoost model to predict large GNSS errors organically without post-hoc heuristic overrides.

issues.description: High Handover Chattering Rate (62.26%). During the 41-minute test drive, the policy executed 106 handovers with 53 classified as unnecessary, and a chattering rate of 62.26% occurring within 2.0s of prior switches.
issues.why_it_matters: High-frequency mode switching destabilizes vehicle control loops and downstream trajectory planning.
issues.recommended_correction: Increase the hysteresis margin epsilon_hyst from 0.5m to 1.5m, and enforce a stricter minimum dwell time tau_dwell = 3.0s (30 epochs at 10 Hz).

issues.description: Stale Parameter Values in config.yaml. config.yaml specifies 'state_dimension: 9' and 'acceptable_error_bound_meters: 10.0', whereas the codebase implements a 6-state EKF and uses E_threshold = 5.0m.
issues.why_it_matters: Creates confusion for external researchers trying to reproduce the codebase from configuration files.
issues.recommended_correction: Update config/config.yaml to state_dimension: 6 and error_threshold_m: 5.0.

issues.description: Lack of Direct Assertions on Action Sensitivity in Test Suite. test_models.py verifies that output arrays exist and are non-negative, but does not assert that e_hat(s_t, 'DR') != e_hat(s_t, 'GNSS').
issues.why_it_matters: A regression where the model ignores action one-hot inputs could still pass unit tests.
issues.recommended_correction: Add a dedicated unit test asserting that changing action candidate yields strictly different predictions on state vectors where GNSS quality is low.

issues.description: Held-Out Testing Limited to Single Physical Route (V-S3a). While V-S3a provides 24,621 epochs (41 minutes) and 20 outage events, it represents a single driving trip in the UK.
issues.why_it_matters: Reviewers will question generalization across different road environments, sensor grades, or vehicle dynamics.
issues.recommended_correction: Document this explicitly as a known limitation in Section 42 / Appendix F (Threats to Validity) and outline multi-route cross-dataset evaluation as future work.

issues.description: Dual Naming Conventions in results/figures/. Both unnumbered figures ('action_ranking_accuracy.png') and publication-numbered figures ('fig01_...png' to 'fig16_...png') reside in the directory.
issues.why_it_matters: Minor duplication and visual clutter in results directory.
issues.recommended_correction: Consolidate results/figures/ onto the canonical numbered naming convention fig01 to fig16.
